 Two children found dead by firefighters responding to a Beloit house fire 
 By Trevor Wymer Published : Nov. 15, 2026 at 8:55 AM CST | Updated : 7 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google BELOIT, Wis. (WMTV) - Two children are dead after a fire broke out at a home in the city of Beloit, according to the City of Beloit.
 The fire happened at about 3:47 a.m. on Sunday in the 1100 block of Hinsdale Avenue.
 Two children were found dead after a house fire in the 100 block of Hinsdale Avenue on Sunday. (City of Beloit Fire Deapartment) Firefighters found the two kids dead inside the home, and an adult was transported to the hospital.
 The names of the kids have not been released, and the Rock County Medical Examiner’s Office is assisting in the investigation.
 City officials did not say what caused the fire.
